```{r functions}
setwd("C:/LocalData/pauliput/OneDrive - University of Helsinki/doc/emerge/processing/")
source("../processing/functions/get_s2_nomask.R")
source("../processing/functions/get_s1.R")


NDVI <- function(nir, red) {
  return ((nir - red) / (nir + red))
}

NDWI <- function(green, nir) {
  return ((green - nir) / (green + nir))
}

NDII <- function(nir, s1) {
  return ((nir - s1) / (nir + s1))
}

EVSI <- function(red, s1) {
  return ((red - s1) / (red + s1))
}

NDGSI <- function(green, s2) {
  return ((green - s2) / (green + s2))
}

MAI <- function(blue, green, red, s1, ls1=1610, lgreen=560, lblue=490) {
  return (green + red - (s1 + (blue - s1)*(ls1 - lgreen) / (ls1 - lblue)))
}

EAVI <- function(s1, s2, green, blue, ls1=1610, lgreen=560, lblue=490) {
  return(s1 + s2 - (green - blue)*(ls1 - lblue)/(ls1 - lgreen))
}

EVI2 <- function(nir, red) {
  return (2.4 * (nir - red) / (nir + red + 1))
}

NDAVI <- function(nir, blue) {
  return ((nir - blue) / (nir + blue))
}

WAVI <- function(nir, blue, L=0.5) {
  return (L*(nir - blue) / (nir + blue + L))
}

calculate_indices <- function(df, sensor) {
  
  if (sensor=="S1") {
    ii <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(df), ncol=2))
    names(ii) <- c("ratio_idan", "ratio_lee")
    ii$ratio_idan <- df[, "VV_idan"] / df[, "VH_idan"]
    ii$ratio_lee <- df[, "VV_lee"] / df[, "VH_lee"]
  }
  else if (sensor == "S2") {
    ii <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(df), ncol=10))
    names(ii) <- c("NDVI", "NDWI", "EVI2", "NDII", "EVSI", "EAVI", "NDGSI", "MAI", "NDAVI", "WAVI")
    ii$NDVI <- NDVI(df$B08_10m, df$B04_10m)
    ii$NDWI <- NDWI(df$B03_10m, df$B08_10m)
    ii$EVI2 <- EVI2(df$B08_10m, df$B04_10m)
    ii$NDII <- NDII(df$B08_10m, df$B11_20m)
    ii$EVSI <- EVSI(df$B04_10m, df$B11_20m)
    ii$EAVI <- EAVI(df$B11_20m, df$B12_20m, df$B03_10m, df$B02_10m)
    ii$NDGSI <- NDGSI(df$B03_10m, df$B12_20m)
    ii$MAI  <- MAI(df$B02_10m, df$B03_10m, df$B04_10m, df$B11_20m)
    ii$NDAVI <- NDAVI(df$B08_10m, df$B02_10m)
    ii$WAVI <- WAVI(df$B08_10m, df$B02_10m)
  }
  else if (sensor == "PS") {
    ii <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(df), ncol=5))
    names(ii) <- c("NDVI", "NDWI", "EVI2", "NDAVI", "WAVI")
    ii$NDVI <- NDVI(df$nir, df$red)
    ii$NDWI <- NDVI(df$green, df$nir)
    ii$EVI2 <- EVI2(df$nir, df$red)
    ii$NDAVI <- NDAVI(df$nir, df$blue)
    ii$WAVI <- WAVI(df$nir, df$blue)
  }
  else {
    cat("Sensor:", sensor, "not recognised!")
    return(NULL)
  }
  return(ii)
}

printConfusionMatrix <- function(d, p, r) {
  dr <- d[d$Predictor == p & d$Response == r,]
  cm <- matrix(nrow=3, ncol=3)
  cm[1:2, 1:2] <- c(dr$tp, dr$fn, dr$fp, dr$tn)
  cm[3, 1:2] <- c(cm[1, 1]/sum(cm[1:2, 1]), cm[2, 2]/sum(cm[1:2, 2]))
  cm[1:2, 3] <- c(cm[1, 1]/sum(cm[1, 1:2]), cm[2, 2]/sum(cm[2, 1:2]))
  cm[3,3] <- sum(cm[1,1], cm[2,2]) / sum(cm[1:2,1:2])
  rownames(cm) <- c("ObsT", "ObsF", "Frac")
  colnames(cm) <- c("PredT", "PredF", "Frac")
  print(cm)
}

```

## Models v2

Here, I clean up the data a little bit by removing grid cells that are mainly land to get rid of excess 1s. I also only build regression models for non-zero coverage values for each response.

```{r clean data and define model variables}
k <- cov_all$land < 0.5
yr <- list(total=cov_all$cov[k], carex=cov_all$carex[k], equisetum=cov_all$equisetum[k], nuphar=cov_all$nuphar[k], sparganium=cov_all$sparganium[k])
yc <- vector(mode="list", length=length(yr))
names(yc) <- names(yr)
for (i in 1:length(yc)) {
  yc[[i]] <- factor(yr[[i]] > 0.001, levels=c(TRUE, FALSE))
}
x2 <- list(s2=predict(preProcess(s2 %>% select(-date, -ID) %>% subset(k), method=c("center", "scale")), s2 %>% select(-date, -ID)) %>% subset(k), s1=predict(preProcess(s1 %>% select(-date) %>% subset(k), method=c("center", "scale")), s1 %>% select(-date) %>% subset(k)), sentinel=predict(preProcess(cbind(s1 %>% select(-date) %>% subset(k), s2 %>% select(-date, -ID) %>% subset(k)), method=c("center", "scale")), cbind(s1 %>% select(-date) %>% subset(k), s2 %>% select(-date, -ID) %>% subset(k))))
pr <- vector(mode="list", length=length(yr))
for (i in 1:length(pr)) {
  pr[[i]] <- createDataPartition(yr[[i]][yc[[i]] == TRUE], p=0.8)[[1]]
}
pc <- vector(mode="list", length=length(yc))
for (i in 1:length(pc)) {
  pc[[i]] <- createDataPartition(yc[[i]], p=0.8)[[1]]
}
cor2 <- vector(mode="list", length=length(x2))
names(cor2) <- names(x2)
for (i in 1:length(x2)) {
  cor2[[i]] <- findCorrelation(cor(x2[[i]]), cutoff=0.9)
}
save(yr, yc, x2, pr, pc, cor2, file=paste0("../model_data/", Sys.Date(), "_model-variables.Rdata"))
```

```{r build classifiers}
classifiers <- vector(mode="list", length=length(yc))
names(classifiers) <- names(yc)
for (i in 1:length(yc)) {
  classifiers[[i]] <- vector(mode="list", length=length(x2))
  names(classifiers[[i]]) <- names(x2)
}

ctrl <- trainControl(method="repeatedcv",
                     number=10,
                     repeats=3,
                     allowParallel=T)
tuning <- expand.grid(interaction.depth = seq(13, 19, 2),
                      n.trees = (5:10)*200,
                      shrinkage = 0.1,
                      n.minobsinnode = 10)

cl <- makePSOCKcluster(6)
registerDoParallel(cl)

for (i in 1:length(yc)) {
  for (j in 1:length(x2)) {
    classifiers[[i]][[j]] <- train(x2[[j]][pc[[i]], -cor2[[j]]],
                              yc[[i]][pc[[i]]],
                              method="gbm",
                              trControl=ctrl,
                              tuneGrid=tuning,
                              verbose=F
    )
    cat("Completed", (i - 1)*length(x) + j, "of", length(yc)*length(x2), "variable combinations.\n")
  }
}
res_cl <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(yc)*length(x2), ncol=13))
names(res_cl) <- c("Predictor", "Response", "OA", "Kappa", "F1", "tp", "fp", "tn", "fn", "Recall", "Specificity", "Precision", "NegPredVal")
for (i in 1:length(yc)) {
  for(j in 1:length(x2)) {
    k <- (i - 1)*length(x2) + j
    pred <- predict(classifiers[[i]][[j]], x2[[j]][-pc[[i]], -cor2[[j]]])
    res_cl$Predictor[k] <- names(x2)[j]
    res_cl$Response[k] <- names(yc)[i]
    res_cl$OA[k] <- sum(pred == yc[[i]][-pc[[i]]]) / length(pred)
    pe <- (sum(pred == T)/length(pred))*(sum(yc[[i]][-pc[[i]]] == T)/length(pred)) + (sum(pred == F)/length(pred))*(sum(yc[[i]][-pc[[i]]] == F)/length(pred))
    res_cl$Kappa[k] <- (res_cl$OA[k] - pe) / (1 - pe)
    res_cl$tp[k] <- sum(pred == TRUE & yc[[i]][-pc[[i]]] == TRUE)
    res_cl$fn[k] <- sum(pred == FALSE & yc[[i]][-pc[[i]]] == TRUE)
    res_cl$fp[k] <- sum(pred == TRUE & yc[[i]][-pc[[i]]] == FALSE)
    res_cl$tn[k] <- sum(pred == FALSE & yc[[i]][-pc[[i]]] == FALSE)
    res_cl$F1[k] <- 2*res_cl$tp[k] / (2*res_cl$tp[k] + res_cl$fp[k] + res_cl$fn[k])
    res_cl$Recall[k] <- res_cl$tp[k] / (res_cl$tp[k] + res_cl$fn[k])
    res_cl$Specificity[k] <- res_cl$tn[k] / (res_cl$tn[k] + res_cl$fp[k])
    res_cl$Precision[k] <- res_cl$tp[k] / (res_cl$tp[k] + res_cl$fp[k])
    res_cl$NegPredVal[k] <- res_cl$tn[k] / (res_cl$tn[k] + res_cl$fn[k])
  }
}
stopCluster(cl)

save(classifiers, res_cl, file=paste0("../model_data/", Sys.Date(), "_classifiers.Rdata"))
```

```{r build regressors}
regressors <- vector(mode="list", length=length(yr))
names(regressors) <- names(yr)
for (i in 1:length(yr)) {
  regressors[[i]] <- vector(mode="list", length=length(x2))
  names(regressors[[i]]) <- names(x2)
}

ctrl <- trainControl(method="repeatedcv",
                     number=10,
                     repeats=3,
                     allowParallel=T)
tuning <- expand.grid(interaction.depth = seq(13, 19, 2),
                      n.trees = (5:10)*200,
                      shrinkage = 0.1,
                      n.minobsinnode = 10)

cl <- makePSOCKcluster(6)
registerDoParallel(cl)

for (i in 1:length(yr)) {
  for (j in 1:length(x2)) {
    regressors[[i]][[j]] <- train(x2[[j]][yc[[i]] == T, ][pr[[i]], -cor2[[j]]],
                              yr[[i]][yc[[i]] == T][pr[[i]]],
                              method="gbm",
                              trControl=ctrl,
                              tuneGrid=tuning,
                              verbose=F
    )
    cat("Completed", (i - 1)*length(x) + j, "of", length(yr)*length(x2), "variable combinations.\n")
  }
}
res_reg <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(yr)*length(x2), ncol=6))
names(res_reg) <- c("Predictor", "Response", "RMSE", "nRMSE", "R2", "MAE")
for (i in 1:length(yr)) {
  for(j in 1:length(x2)) {
    k <- (i - 1)*length(x2) + j
    pred <- predict(regressors[[i]][[j]], x2[[j]][yc[[i]] == T, ][-pr[[i]], -cor2[[j]]])
    res_reg$Predictor[k] <- names(x2)[j]
    res_reg$Response[k] <- names(yr)[i]
    res_reg$RMSE[k] <- sqrt(mean((pred - yr[[i]][yc[[i]] == T][-pr[[i]]])^2))
    res_reg$nRMSE[k] <- res_reg$RMSE[k] / mean(yr[[i]][yc[[i]] == T][-pr[[i]]])
    res_reg$R2[k] <- 1 - sum((pred - yr[[i]][yc[[i]] == T][-pr[[i]]])^2) / sum((yr[[i]][yc[[i]] == T][-pr[[i]]] - mean(yr[[i]][yc[[i]] == T][-pr[[i]]]))^2)
    res_reg$MAE[k] <- mean(abs(pred - yr[[i]][yc[[i]] == T][-pr[[i]]]))
  }
}
stopCluster(cl)

save(regressors, res_reg, file=paste0("../model_data/", Sys.Date(), "_regressors.Rdata"))
```

```{r predict 2024 july}
pj_equisetum[pj_equisetum > 0.5] <- 0.5

pj_sparganium[pj_sparganium > 0.5] <- 0.5

s2_pj_cs <- (s2_pj - colMeans((s2 %>% select(-date, -ID))[,-which_vars$s2])) / apply((s2 %>% select(-date, -ID))[,-which_vars$s2], 2, sd)

pj_s2_total_reg <- predict(s2_pj_cs, regressors$total$s2)

pj_s2_total[pj_s2_total < 0] <- 0
pj_s2_total[pj_s2_total > 0.5] <- 0.5

s1_pj_cs <- (s1_pj - colMeans((s1 %>% select(-date))[,-which_vars$s1])) / apply((s1 %>% select(-date))[,-which_vars$s1], 2, sd)

pj_s1_total_reg <- predict(s1_pj_cs, regressors$total$s1)

pj_s1_total[pj_s1_total < 0] <- 0
pj_s1_total[pj_s1_total > 0.5] <- 0.5

writeRaster(s1, "C:/LocalData/pauliput/OneDrive - University of Helsinki/doc/emerge/rasters/july_s1_predictors.tif")
writeRaster(s2, "C:/LocalData/pauliput/OneDrive - University of Helsinki/doc/emerge/rasters/july_s2_predictors.tif")
```

## Models v3

Building models with all training data, but using only cov > 0 for evaluation

```{r clean data and define model variables}
k <- cov_all$land < 0.2
y3 <- list(total=cov_all$cov[k], carex=cov_all$carex[k], equisetum=cov_all$equisetum[k], nuphar=cov_all$nuphar[k], sparganium=cov_all$sparganium[k])
x3 <- list(s2=predict(preProcess(s2 %>% select(-date, -ID) %>% subset(k), method=c("center", "scale")), s2 %>% select(-date, -ID)) %>% subset(k), s1=predict(preProcess(s1 %>% select(-date) %>% subset(k), method=c("center", "scale")), s1 %>% select(-date) %>% subset(k)), sentinel=predict(preProcess(cbind(s1 %>% select(-date) %>% subset(k), s2 %>% select(-date, -ID) %>% subset(k)), method=c("center", "scale")), cbind(s1 %>% select(-date) %>% subset(k), s2 %>% select(-date, -ID) %>% subset(k))))
pr <- vector(mode="list", length=length(y3))
for (i in 1:length(pr)) {
  pr[[i]] <- which(!(1:length(y3[[i]]) %in% (which(y3[[i]] > 0)[createDataPartition(y3[[i]][y3[[i]] > 0], p=0.2)[[1]]])))
}
cor3 <- vector(mode="list", length=length(x3))
names(cor3) <- names(x3)
for (i in 1:length(x3)) {
  cor3[[i]] <- findCorrelation(cor(x3[[i]]), cutoff=0.9)
}
save(y3, x3, pr, cor3, file=paste0("../model_data/", Sys.Date(), "_model-variables.Rdata"))
```


```{r build regressors}
load("../model_data/2024-11-21_model-variables.Rdata")
regressors <- vector(mode="list", length=length(y3))
names(regressors) <- names(y3)
for (i in 1:length(y3)) {
  regressors[[i]] <- vector(mode="list", length=length(x2))
  names(regressors[[i]]) <- names(x3)
}

ctrl <- trainControl(method="repeatedcv",
                     number=10,
                     repeats=3,
                     allowParallel=T)
tuning <- expand.grid(interaction.depth = seq(13, 19, 2),
                      n.trees = (5:10)*200,
                      shrinkage = 0.1,
                      n.minobsinnode = 10)

cl <- makePSOCKcluster(6)
registerDoParallel(cl)

for (i in 1:length(y3)) {
  for (j in 1:length(x3)) {
    regressors[[i]][[j]] <- train(x3[[j]][pr[[i]], -cor3[[j]]],
                              y3[[i]][pr[[i]]],
                              method="gbm",
                              trControl=ctrl,
                              tuneGrid=tuning,
                              verbose=F
    )
    cat("Completed", (i - 1)*length(x3) + j, "of", length(y3)*length(x3), "variable combinations.\n")
  }
}
res_reg <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(y3)*length(x3), ncol=6))
names(res_reg) <- c("Predictor", "Response", "RMSE", "nRMSE", "R2", "MAE")
for (i in 1:length(y3)) {
  for(j in 1:length(x3)) {
    k <- (i - 1)*length(x3) + j
    pred <- predict(regressors[[i]][[j]], x3[[j]][-pr[[i]], -cor3[[j]]])
    res_reg$Predictor[k] <- names(x3)[j]
    res_reg$Response[k] <- names(y3)[i]
    res_reg$RMSE[k] <- sqrt(mean((pred - y3[[i]][-pr[[i]]])^2))
    res_reg$nRMSE[k] <- res_reg$RMSE[k] / max(y3[[i]])
    res_reg$R2[k] <- 1 - sum((pred - y3[[i]][-pr[[i]]])^2) / sum((y3[[i]][-pr[[i]]] - mean(y3[[i]][-pr[[i]]]))^2)
    res_reg$MAE[k] <- mean(abs(pred - y3[[i]][-pr[[i]]]))
  }
}
stopCluster(cl)

save(regressors, res_reg, file=paste0("../model_data/", Sys.Date(), "_regressors.Rdata"))
```

```{r catchment}
                   group_by(Class) %>% 
                   mutate(Coverage=(catchment_cov - catchment_cov[Date == "2024-05-30"]) / (max(catchment_cov) - catchment_cov[Date == "2024-05-30"]))
                 ) %>% 
  mutate(Class = factor(Class, levels=c("Total", "Floating", "Emergent", "Carex", "Equisetum", "Nuphar", "Sparganium"), 
         labels=c("Total", "Floating-leaved", "Emergent", "<i>Carex</i> spp.", "<i>E. fluviatile</i>", "<i>N. lutea</i>", "<i>Sparganium</i> spp."))) %>%
  group_by(Class, Date) %>%
  reframe(LAI=mean(LAI, na.rm=T), Coverage=Coverage) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Date, y=LAI, colour=Class)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point(aes(y=Coverage)) + 
  facet_wrap(vars(Class), scales="free_y", ncol=4) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  scale_colour_manual(values=c7) + 
  theme(text=element_text(family="Aptos"),
        strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(),
        legend.position = "none") + 
  ylab("LAI / Coverage (normalised)") -> p
  # scale_size_manual(values = c("Field" = .5, "Satellite" = 1.5), limits = c("Field", "Satellite")) + 
  # scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("Field" = .5, "Satellite" = 1.5), limits = c("Field", "Satellite")) + 
  # labs(size = "Type", linewidth = NULL, colour="Class") + 
  # guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = c("solid", "blank"), shape = c(NA, 16))))
ggsave(filename=paste0(Sys.Date(), "_timeseries-validation.png"), plot=p, device="png", path=fig_dir, width=159.2, height=80, units="mm", dpi="print")
ggsave(filename=paste0(Sys.Date(), "_timeseries-validation.pdf"), plot=p, device=cairo_pdf, path=fig_dir, width=159.2, height=80, units="mm")

```
